title: Learn Butoh | Episode 0: Introduction | Lessons in Dark Dance

method.teacher_system: The teacher introduces Butoh by sharing his personal background and connection to dance. He explains the fundamental concept of 'life resonance' and the essence of the dance. Finally, he outlines the history and founders of Butoh to provide context for the lessons.
method.signature: Explaining Butoh through deep philosophical and historical roots before teaching technique

practices.what: Introduce the controversial form of dance from Japan called Butoh.
Explain the concept of life resonance as a prerequisite for understanding Butoh.
Discuss the creators of Butoh, Kazuo Ohno and Tatsumi Hijikata.
Explain the historical context of Butoh arising after World War II in Japan.

beliefs.belief: Dance gets in touch with dark places that everyone has hidden.
Resonating with everything in life opens an open channel to understanding.

moments.says: The teacher introduces himself and announces an upcoming lesson on Butoh.

requests.theme: Asking if dancing butoh has a cathartic effect
Asking if the style is related to contemporary dance

meant.theme: Described live butoh performance as an unforgettable experience

method.limits: The video is an introductory talk about the history and philosophy of Butoh rather than a physical movement lesson.
